GeneratedBy.Name: Authors' HFA extraction (FieldTrip May 2021 + custom MATLAB)
GeneratedBy.Description: Bellier et al. 2023 Methods: song-aligned data with 10 s padding; notch 60 Hz and harmonics to 300 Hz; 1 Hz high-pass; 20-Hz sub-bands 70-150 Hz (5-Hz steps), median common average reference per sub-band, Hilbert envelope, robust scaling, average across sub-bands; pads removed; downsampled to 100 Hz; samples above 7 SD tagged as outliers. Recording at 1200 Hz (g.USBamp, BCI2000) at Albany Medical Center. Performed by the authors; raw recordings were not released.
